compartments.text_span: Individuals who are susceptible to cholera infection.

compartments.text_span: Individuals who are infected with cholera but do not show symptoms. They can shed bacteria and contribute to transmission.
compartments.description: Individuals who are infected with cholera but do not show symptoms. They can shed bacteria and contribute to transmission.

compartments.text_span: Individuals who are infected with cholera and show clinical symptoms. They shed bacteria, often at a higher rate than asymptomatic individuals.

compartments.text_span: Individuals who have recovered from cholera infection and are assumed to have acquired immunity.

compartments.text_span: Concentration of V. cholerae in the water reservoir that have lost their hyperinfectivity.

compartments.text_span: Individuals who have died from cholera infection.

parameters.text_span: Rate of 'contact' with reservoir water, representing the maximum infection rate from the environmental reservoir.

parameters.description: Per capita recovery rate from cholera infection. The reciprocal (1/γ) is the duration of infection.

parameters.description: Decay or removal rate of cholera bacteria in the water reservoir. The reciprocal (1/δ) is the cholera life span in water.

parameters.text_span: Concentration of cholera bacteria that yields a 50% chance of infection (half-saturation constant).
